meta.name: StudioSpace Mock Dataset
notes: totalPrice = hourlyRate x durationHours; securityDeposit is stored separately and is not included in totalPrice.
Studio averageRating and reviewCount are derived from the reviews collection (averageRating is 0 when reviewCount is 0).
Image URLs use picsum.photos seeded placeholders and randomuser.me portraits; replace with real assets for production.
All people, emails and addresses are fictional. No credentials are included.

studios.title: Open Canvas Creator Classroom
studios.address: 520 West 27th Street, Suite 6, Chelsea, New York, NY 10001, USA
studios.overview: A flexible classroom-style studio in Chelsea built for painting workshops, illustration classes, and creator meetups. Twenty adjustable easels, a skylit ceiling, and a wall of storage cabinets provide everything needed for a messy, productive session. A projector, speaker system, and charging stations support digital art demos, while a cleanup sink and tarp-covered floor mean nobody needs to worry about spills. Perfect for team-building and evening sip-and-paint events.

studios.title: Velvet Mic Podcast Lounge
studios.address: 37 Bedford Avenue, Williamsburg, Brooklyn, NY 11211, USA
studios.overview: A plush Williamsburg podcast lounge with velvet armchairs, warm lighting, and four broadcast-quality microphones on adjustable boom arms. The room is acoustically treated with fabric panels and a floating floor, so interviews sound crisp and intimate. Hosts can record audio only or capture multi-camera video with the built-in 4K setup. A mixing desk with live monitoring and a comfortable waiting nook for guests round out a polished experience for new and established shows.

studios.title: Golden Hour Portrait Loft
studios.address: 148 Greene Street, Floor 4, SoHo, New York, NY 10012, USA
studios.overview: A sun-drenched fourth-floor loft in SoHo with west-facing arched windows that flood the space with warm, directional light from mid-afternoon until sunset. Exposed brick, a weathered oak floor, and two seamless paper backdrops give portrait and lifestyle photographers a flexible canvas. A compact styling corner with a steamer and full-length mirror keeps shoots moving, while the freight elevator makes hauling gear and props effortless.

studios.title: Terracotta Courtyard Studio
studios.address: Calle Durango 215, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, 06700 Mexico City, Mexico
studios.overview: A warm, sun-baked courtyard studio in Roma Norte wrapped in terracotta walls, climbing bougainvillea, and handcrafted tile. Shoot outdoors in open shade or retreat to the covered gallery with continuous lighting available on request. Popular with travel, fashion, and brand photographers who want a distinctive Mexican aesthetic, the venue offers a rooftop view of the neighborhood, a small prop library of ceramics and textiles, and bilingual assistance on site.

studios.title: The Brew & Broadcast Room
studios.address: 63 Brick Lane, London E1 6QL, United Kingdom
studios.overview: Located above a specialty coffee roastery in Shoreditch, this cozy podcast room pairs excellent acoustics with a warm, café-inspired atmosphere. Guests get a complimentary flat white on arrival, and the room features five dynamic microphones, a Rodecaster Pro mixer, and two remote-controlled cameras. Wooden slat diffusers keep reflections under control, and a simple booking-to-record flow means first-time podcasters can start talking within minutes.

studios.title: Print & Press Collective
studios.address: 12 Redchurch Street, London E2 7DJ, United Kingdom
studios.overview: A working printmaking studio with a Vandercook letterpress, a screen-printing station, an etching press, and a library of wooden type and inks. Artists, designers, and teachers use the space for workshops on poster printing, bookbinding, and risograph techniques. Large flat files store paper stock, and bright north-facing windows offer excellent working light. Techniques are taught by resident printers who are happy to offer guidance.

studios.title: The Black Box Backlot
studios.address: Unit 7, Hackney Wick Yard, Wallis Road, London E9 5LN, United Kingdom
studios.overview: A versatile black-box film space in Hackney Wick that suits short films, brand content, and rehearsed dramatic scenes. Walls and ceiling are fully acoustically treated, with a ceiling grid, total blackout capability, and a pre-wired intercom. A modular set-build area and workshop let art departments construct and strike sets on-site. Canal-side loading, a quiet green room, and fast fiber internet for dailies make this a practical base for independent crews.

studios.title: The Maker's Table
studios.address: Avenida Álvaro Obregón 94, Roma Norte, 06700 Mexico City, Mexico
studios.overview: A communal workshop space in Roma Norte organized around a twelve-foot reclaimed-wood table, ideal for design sprints, craft classes, and brand activations. Whiteboards, a projector, and wall rails for hanging prints let teams adapt the room fast. Kitchen facilities allow caterers to serve fresh coffee and snacks, and a back patio is perfect for breaks. Flexible furniture and plentiful power strips make setup quick for groups of all sizes.

studios.title: Washi & Woodblock Craft Studio
studios.address: 1-9-3 Yanaka, Taito City, Tokyo 110-0001, Japan
studios.overview: A traditional craft studio in the historic Yanaka neighborhood where small groups learn washi papermaking, woodblock carving, and mokuhanga printing. Low tables, hanging drying racks, and a full set of chisels, barens, and mulberry paper are provided. The tatami-floored room offers a tranquil atmosphere, and a visiting master printmaker can be booked to teach classes in English or Japanese for a unique cultural creative experience.

studios.title: Clay & Kiln Ceramics Workshop
studios.address: Via Ripamonti 120, 20141 Milan, Italy
studios.overview: A fully equipped ceramics workshop with eight wheels, two electric kilns, a slab roller, and a glazing station stocked with food-safe glazes. Instructors and community groups host throwing classes, hand-building sessions, and glaze experiments in a bright, easy-to-clean room with industrial sinks. Aprons, tools, and basic clay are provided, and firing services are available at a modest fee, so participants leave with finished pieces.

studios.title: Maple Leaf Green Screen Stage
studios.address: 88 Eastern Avenue, Corktown, Toronto, ON M5A 1H5, Canada
studios.overview: A purpose-built chroma key stage in Corktown with a 40-foot seamless green cyc, a floor that matches the wall, and even, flicker-free lighting designed to make post-production keying painless. Teams shoot commercials, explainers, and VFX plates here, with a green room, makeup station, and teleprompter available. A client-friendly control area with large monitors and Wi-Fi allows producers to review takes live while editors prepare dailies.

studios.title: Kick & Snare Rehearsal Room
studios.address: Revaler Straße 99, 10245 Berlin, Germany
studios.overview: A sturdy, no-frills rehearsal room for bands who need volume without complaints. Concrete walls are lined with acoustic panels, and the room comes with a full drum kit, bass and guitar amps, a PA system, and four vocal mics. Located in a converted factory near Ostkreuz, it has 24-hour access, a communal chill-out space, and storage lockers for gear. Affordable hourly rates make it ideal for regular weekly practice.

studios.title: Echo Chamber Audio Den
studios.address: Via Tortona 32, 20144 Milan, Italy
studios.overview: A discreet, compact recording den in the Tortona design district, perfect for voice-over artists, audiobook narrators, and solo podcast creators. A floating booth with dense acoustic foam delivers a near-silent noise floor, and a large-diaphragm condenser microphone with a pop filter and vintage preamp sits ready on a stand. Remote clients can connect via broadcast-quality IP codecs, and an attentive engineer is available for hire to monitor takes and edit audio.

studios.title: Northern Lights Talk House
studios.address: 410 Queen Street West, Toronto, ON M5V 2A7, Canada
studios.overview: A modern, glass-fronted talk house on Queen Street West created for video podcasts and live-streamed conversations. Three-camera switching, a customizable LED backdrop, and soft key lighting give shows a professional broadcast look. Six microphones with individual gain control keep voices balanced, and a streaming workstation lets producers go live to YouTube or Twitch. Soundproof doors, a green room, and street-level access make it a hub for the city's creator community.

studios.title: Lumière Fashion Pavilion
studios.address: 18 Rue de Paradis, 75010 Paris, France
studios.overview: An elegant Haussmann-era pavilion in the 10th arrondissement transformed into a high-end fashion studio, with soaring ceilings, ornate moldings, and a polished concrete shooting floor. Tall casement windows provide beautiful daylight while a full tungsten and strobe kit handles night sessions. A wardrobe room with garment racks, a makeup lounge with backlit mirrors, and a champagne-ready green room make it a favorite for lookbooks and campaigns.

studios.title: Analog Dreams Recording Suite
studios.address: Via Savona 54, 20144 Milan, Italy
studios.overview: A classic analog-meets-digital recording suite in Milan with a restored 32-channel console, a warm live room, and a vocal booth lined with oak diffusers. Outboard compressors and equalizers, vintage microphones, and a collection of guitars and amplifiers let bands and producers chase authentic textures. A dedicated engineer is optional, and ample parking and a lounge with an espresso machine keep long tracking days comfortable and creative.

studios.title: Neon Alley Set Studio
studios.address: 2-5-14 Shinkiba, Koto City, Tokyo 136-0082, Japan
studios.overview: Step into a permanent cyberpunk-style alley set complete with working neon signage, wet-look asphalt flooring, vending machines, and layered street-level facades. Directors use it for music videos, fashion films, and sci-fi shorts without spending days building an environment. Fog machines, haze, and programmable LED strips are included, and an adjacent flat room doubles as a conventional shooting space. Bilingual studio staff assist with power and rigging.

studios.title: Midnight Synth Garage
studios.address: Alserkal Avenue, Unit 22, Al Quoz 1, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
studios.overview: A synth-lover's hideaway in Al Quoz packed with modular systems, drum machines, and vintage keyboards patched into a compact control room. Producers and electronic artists can sketch, sequence, and record immersive tracks with an analog polysynth and a Eurorack rig on hand. Acoustic treatment, precise studio monitors, and neon-lit mood lighting set the tone, and late-night sessions are encouraged with extended access available on request.

studios.title: Sakura Light Room
studios.address: 3-12-8 Kiyosumi, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0024, Japan
studios.overview: A calm, minimalist shooting room in Kiyosumi designed around soft north-facing window light and a cherry-blossom-toned wall that photographs beautifully for portraits, product work, and editorial flat lays. Sliding shoji-style diffusers let you shape contrast throughout the day. The studio is intentionally small and tidy, ideal for solo creators or two-person teams, with a tatami reading nook for reviewing images and a tea service for sessions.

studios.title: Monochrome Cyclorama Hall
studios.address: 1825 Industrial Street, Arts District, Los Angeles, CA 90021, USA
studios.overview: Built for commercial and fashion productions, this 2,400-square-foot hall features a pure white hard-cove cyclorama with a motorized blackout curtain system. A rigging grid overhead holds strobes and modifiers at any angle, and a dedicated tethering station lets art directors approve frames in real time. Drive-in loading access, ample parking, and a separate hair and makeup suite mean even large crews can set up in under an hour.

studios.title: Orchestral Hall Session Room
studios.address: 42 Quai de la Loire, 75019 Paris, France
studios.overview: A grand session room with a six-meter ceiling, a concert grand piano, and floor space for a chamber orchestra or choir of up to twenty musicians. Natural reverb is tuned with movable baffles, and the control room offers a large analog console and a comprehensive microphone locker. Film composers and classical ensembles value the quiet canal-side location, the on-site piano tuner, and the green room stocked with music stands.

studios.title: The Greenhouse Daylight Atelier
studios.address: Prinzenstraße 85, 10969 Berlin, Germany
studios.overview: Housed in a restored glass-roofed nursery in Kreuzberg, this atelier surrounds you with real plants, whitewashed brick, and diffused overhead daylight that never gets harsh. It excels at botanical editorials, styling tests, and natural-light portraits. Movable greenery, vintage wooden tables, and three neutral backdrops give you endless set variations, and an adjoining kitchenette lets food and beverage photographers prep without leaving the space.

studios.title: Blue Note Jazz Parlor
studios.address: 2210 Sunset Place, Echo Park, Los Angeles, CA 90026, USA
studios.overview: An intimate live-room studio built for jazz, soul, and acoustic ensembles, with a well-tuned grand piano, an upright bass, and a vintage Hammond organ. Warm wood paneling and adjustable acoustic panels produce a natural, flattering room sound, while isolation booths let horn and vocal players track without bleed. Two engineers are available, and a cozy lounge with a record collection invites musicians to unwind between takes.

studios.title: Dunes Virtual Production Volume
studios.address: Warehouse 14, Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
studios.overview: A dedicated LED volume for in-camera visual effects, featuring a curved wall of high-resolution panels, camera tracking, and real-time engine operators available on request. Commercial and film crews can shoot desert sunsets, alien worlds, or luxury interiors in a single afternoon with accurate reflections on the talent and props. A control room, client viewing lounge, and generous loading bay support large productions with demanding technical requirements.

studios.title: Lagoon Talk Studio
studios.address: Rua da Boavista 77, 1200-066 Lisbon, Portugal
studios.overview: A bright, plant-filled podcast studio in central Lisbon with a round oak table, six boom-mounted microphones, and soundproofed walls hidden behind tasteful cork panels. The setup suits roundtable shows, panel discussions, and language-learning series. Natural light filters in through frosted windows for video recordings, and the venue includes a mini-fridge, a quiet restroom, and a reference monitor so guests can listen back without leaving their seats.

studios.title: Soundstage Nine
studios.address: 6410 Santa Monica Boulevard, Hollywood, Los Angeles, CA 90038, USA
studios.overview: A fully soundproofed 6,000-square-foot Hollywood soundstage with a 28-foot ceiling, heavy-duty lighting grid, and three-phase power for demanding productions. Build large sets on the floor, use the hard-wall flat for green-screen work, or hang cycs for commercial shoots. Production offices, a wardrobe department, two dressing rooms, and a catering-ready lobby sit alongside the stage, so features, music videos, and commercials can run from a single address.

studios.title: Padma Podcast Pod
studios.address: House 14, Road 7, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209, Bangladesh
studios.overview: An affordable, soundproof pod in Dhanmondi built for solo creators, voice actors, and one-on-one interviews. A broadcast microphone, closed-back headphones, and a laptop-ready interface are all included, making it simple to record clean audio on a budget. Heavy acoustic curtains and double doors keep out the street noise, while reliable power backup and air conditioning ensure uninterrupted sessions even during load shedding. A small lounge area is available for guests waiting between takes.

studios.title: Tide Studio Vocal Booth Suite
studios.address: Plot 22, Road 11, Banani, Dhaka 1213, Bangladesh
studios.overview: A professional vocal production suite in Banani offering a treated live room, a large-diaphragm condenser microphone, and a control room with nearfield monitors. Singers, rappers, and songwriters can record demos and releases with the help of an in-house engineer, and mixing services are available. Comfortable acoustic design, stable air conditioning, and a quiet neighborhood make it a go-to for the city's growing independent music scene.

studios.title: Indigo Textile Dye House
studios.address: House 31, Lake Road, Uttara, Dhaka 1230, Bangladesh
studios.overview: A hands-on textile studio in Uttara focused on natural dyeing, block printing, and handloom weaving. Large vats of indigo, turmeric, and madder root sit alongside printing tables and drying lines on a sun-filled rooftop. Local artisans can lead classes for groups, and the space is ideal for fashion students, sustainable brands, and craft collectives. Safe water drainage and gloves are provided for every participant.

studios.title: Harbor Warehouse Stage
studios.address: Armazém 6, Doca de Santo Amaro, 1350-352 Lisbon, Portugal
studios.overview: A converted waterfront warehouse near Santo Amaro dock with brick walls, steel trusses, and a 12-meter clear span that works for period dramas, industrial scenes, and documentary reenactments. Rolling doors open directly onto a quiet quay for exterior setups, and the space can be darkened completely for controlled lighting. Affordable day rates and flexible hours appeal to emerging directors, while on-site power and parking keep logistics simple.

reviews.comment: Soundstage Nine lives up to the name. Power was plentiful, the grid was ready, and the stage was genuinely silent between takes. Our crew of twenty-five still had room to spare.
A synth paradise. I got completely lost in the modular rig for the whole session and left with three finished sketches. The monitors are crisp and the neon lighting really helps the creative mood.
Loud, sturdy, and affordable. The drum kit was in good shape and the PA handled our full band easily. Having a gear locker saves us hauling everything every week.
A roundtable of six fit comfortably and the cork panels killed any echo. The location is easy to find and the host was welcoming. We recorded three episodes back to back.

The afternoon light through those arched windows is unreal. We finished a full set of team headshots in under two hours without touching a strobe, and the steamer and backdrops were already waiting when we arrived.

Good vocal chain and a helpful engineer, but our session started thirty minutes late because the previous client overran. The recorded sound quality was great, so I would try again with a slot earlier in the day.
That flat white on arrival is a great touch. The Rodecaster made recording painless, even for my first-time guest, and the two cameras gave us a decent video cut without any extra setup.
Plush, warm, and it sounds incredible. We left with polished audio and ready-to-post video clips from the built-in cameras. Our guest said it was the most comfortable chair she had ever recorded in.
A fascinating space with beautiful natural dyes, but the rooftop drying area was crowded with another class and we had to wait for space. The instructors were lovely and patient.
Compact but truly soundproof, so no street noise at all. The power backup kicked in during an outage and we did not lose a single take. Best for one or two people.
A dream for printmakers. The Vandercook is beautifully maintained, and the resident printer shared tips we would never have found on our own. Our group of students did not want to leave.
Gorgeous loft and the freight elevator saved us on a day with a lot of props. Daylight fades quickly in the late afternoon, so book an earlier slot if natural light matters to you.
Great classroom for our painting night. The easels and cleanup sink were lifesavers, and the skylight is lovely. The speaker system was a bit quiet for a room full of people.
The grand piano and the room sound are gorgeous. We recorded a live jazz set with almost no post-production, and the isolation booths kept the horns clean.

Shooting among real plants under that glass roof felt like building a magazine set from scratch. The vintage tables worked perfectly for our botanical flat lays, and the kitchenette was handy for prepping drinks.
Massive and well run. Having production offices and dressing rooms on-site saved us a day of logistics. The lobby gets tight when catering and the crew are both in, but that is a minor complaint.
We ran a beginner throwing class for ten people. Every wheel was in great shape, and the kiln firing service meant everyone left with a finished mug. Highly recommend for community classes.
Professional-grade cyc and a tethering station that made client approvals painless. Our full fashion crew loaded in within twenty minutes, and the hair and makeup suite kept everyone comfortable.
Clean, evenly lit green that keyed effortlessly in post. The teleprompter worked well for our explainer series, and the producer monitors let the client follow along live.
Great sound and a very cozy room. With four people around the table it gets a little tight, but the boom arms kept the mics out of the way and the audio came out clean.
Very quiet booth, and the vintage preamp added real warmth to my narration. Exactly what I needed for my audiobook chapters. The rate is a little high for solo creators, but the sound justifies it.

The LED volume looks incredible, but camera tracking calibration swallowed the first ninety minutes of our booking. Once everything was running, the in-camera reflections were fantastic and the operators were very professional.
Gorgeous hall and a lovely piano, perfect for our string quartet recording. The heating was slow to warm up on a cold morning, but the acoustics more than made up for it.
The cyc itself is beautiful, but one softbox was missing from the strobe kit and the hall took a while to cool down. The host sorted it out fast, though, and the rest of the session went smoothly.
Solid black box with excellent acoustics. The set-build area let us construct our kitchen scene on-site, and the internet was fast enough to review dailies the same evening.
Real console, real live room, and some wonderful guitars to borrow. We tracked an entire EP in two days and the engineer was brilliant at coaxing great drum sounds.
Quiet, tidy, and the window light is soft enough to flatter every skin tone. The tea service and the tatami nook for reviewing frames were lovely touches. Perfect for a small two-person team.
Elegant, spacious, and everything was ready for us: steamer, garment racks, mirrors. Our lookbook shoot wrapped an hour ahead of schedule thanks to the wardrobe room next door.
Perfect space for our two-day design sprint. The table is a showpiece and the patio gave us breathing room between sessions. We needed a few extra extension cords for all our laptops.
We shot an entire music video in the alley set without spending a day on set design. Neon, haze, and the wet-look floor delivered exactly the mood we pitched to the label.
